name: 23_redeem_twice_with_tail
description: A holder redeems in two batches with a tail claim in between, exercising the redemption-body tail catch-up (S6). b1 parks 40 of its 100 units in a transfer window ask, redeems the other 60, claims the tail (advancing its cursor to T0), then the series-terminal window NoMatches and returns the 40 units (S3); b1 redeems that second batch and is credited the [0, T0] tail slice on the 40 units immediately (catch-up, cursor not reset), then a second liquidity event grows the tail to T1 and b1 claims the [T0, T1] slice on all 100 — so b1's total tail equals 100 units × T1 and nothing strands. Without the catch-up the 40-unit [0, T0] slice would be permanently locked in the vault.

redeemed while b1's 40 units sit in the window escrow; unitsAtRedemption 400
batch 1: b1 redeems its 60-unit balance (redeemedUnits 60; tail cursor still 0)

a proposal on a now-Redeemed series

batch 2: b1 redeems the returned 40; the catch-up credits the [0, T0] tail slice on them (cursor not reset)
batch 2 paid redemption 40 × 118044912 + tail catch-up 684000000 (the [0, T0] slice that would otherwise strand); redeemedUnits 100
second liquidity event grows the tail to T1
b1 claims the [T0, T1] slice on all 100 redeemed units
all 400 units' tail paid across both events; b1's two batches each got their full slice; vault empty, nothing stranded
